title: SIG/CAIQ response hub and customer quick-attestation flow
creator: Evan Park
description:
Objective: Create a centralized "SIG/CAIQ Response Hub" and a lightweight 'Quick Attestation' customer flow. The hub will house canonical answers, approved evidence links, and machine-readable metadata for each SIG/CAIQ question and related attestations. The Quick Attestation flow lets Sales/Solutions Engineering generate a signed PDF attestation bundle and a short customer-facing summary in < 15 minutes using pre-approved templates and evidence links. This reduces legal review cycles and shortens sales contract close time for mid-market and enterprise customers.

Scope:
- Canonical answers for SIG/CAIQ v2.0 mapped to evidence artifacts (confluence, runbooks, audit logs).
- Web UI in Console for internal users to search, edit, and version canonical answers (RBAC restricted).
- API to generate customer-specific attestation bundles: templated cover letter, selected Q&A, evidence links, and metadata for pricing/contracting systems.
- 'Quick Attestation' flow embedded in Sales workspace: pick attack surface (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), select canned answers, attach auto-generated evidence links, flag items for Legal review.
- Telemetry: time-to-generate, legal review time, conversion lift (deal stage velocity), and number of attestation bundles generated.
- Integration points: Contracting (salesforce/CRM webhook), Pricing experiments (attestation-bundles as add-on SKUs), and Dedicated onboarding flow.

Out of scope for this first increment: full automated evidence collection (we will link to artifacts rather than ingest them), signed SSO integrations for customers, and on-prem packaging of the hub (Private deployment will be supported later).

Why now: Repeated requests from Enterprise AE and Solutions teams to speed up SIG/CAIQ response generation have added ~2–4 weeks to sales cycles on average. This is a recurring blocker as Private and Dedicated deals scale. Early experiments (PM-11783) showed a 20% reduction in review time when using templated answers. We want a productized, auditable solution that also surfaces pricing options for attestation bundles.

Success metrics (first 90 days after release):
- Median attestation generation time <= 15 minutes (target: 10 minutes).
- Reduce average legal review time for attestations by 40%.
- 25% decrease in time-to-close for deals requiring SIG/CAIQ (tracked by CRM).
- >80% reuse rate of canonical answers across customers (measure: distinct answers used / total answers selected).

Acceptance criteria:
1) Internal Console feature that lists SIG/CAIQ questions with editable canonical answers and evidence links; changes are versioned.
2) API endpoint that produces a downloadable attestation bundle (PDF) with cover letter, selected Q&A, evidence links, and metadata.
3) Sales Quick Flow prototype wired into CRM (Salesforce testcase) to attach attestation bundle to opportunity and record timestamps.
4) Legal gating: ability to flag and surface items that require Legal review; triage queue visible to Legal team.
5) Audit log for who generated/edited an attestation and which evidence links were included.

Telemetry & instrumentation needs:
- Events: attestation.created, attestation.queued_for_legal, attestation.signed, attestation.attached_to_opportunity.
- Metrics dashboard: median generation time, legal review latency, bundles per AE, conversion lift elastic.

Risks & mitigations:
- Inaccurate canonical answers -> mitigate via mandatory second reviewer sign-off for answers marked 'unstable' and a 30-day review cadence.
- Legal pushback about auto-generation -> require explicit Legal review flag and keep auto-generation read-only for items under review.
- Evidence link rot -> include link validation checks and a lightweight health check job.

Rollout plan:
- Week 0–2: Design + technical spec + Legal sign-off on workflow.
- Week 3–6: Implement Console + core API + basic PDF template + CRM integration prototype.
- Week 7: Internal dogfood with 4 AE pilots (target: Security-conscious prospects).
- Week 8–9: Iterate on feedback, add telemetry, and finalize a pricing experiment for attestation bundles.
- Week 10: Gradual roll (opt-in orgs) -> full rollout to Sales org if no blocking Legal concerns.

Pricing experiment notes:
- Test adding a low-friction attestation bundle SKU (one-time, small fee or included in enterprise tier) vs. free but SLA-limited option.
- Measure attach/checkout rates and whether including the bundle shortens sales cycles enough to justify price.
